newsitem.title: USA: NHL to release statement on expansion committee.
newsitem.headline: NHL to release statement on expansion committee.

text.p: The National Hockey League is expected to release a statement at about 1315 EDT Tuesday on reports about possible league expansion, a spokesman said.
Media reports on Monday stated the NHL's expansion committee would recommend awarding franchises to Atlanta, Nashville, St. Paul and Columbus, Ohio.
A Nashville franchise would join the league in 1998, followed by Atlanta in 1999 and St. Paul and Columbus in 2000, media reports said.
